verdict.rationale: Orama documents a programmatic API: the open-source library exposes create, insert, insertMultiple and search with facets, vector and hybrid modes, and Orama Cloud officially ships JavaScript/TypeScript, Python and Rust SDKs whose APIs mirror the open-source ones. However, no public HTTP/REST API reference appears in the evidence, and a probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path, so the extent of the remote API surface is unproven. missing for 10: a documented Cloud REST/HTTP API reference, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product end-to-end via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: We can create a new instance (from now on database) with an **indexing `schema`**.
If you have a lot of records, we suggest using the `insertMultiple` function
To do so, we need to specify the facets property in the search configuration
Orama Cloud officially supports the following SDKs: - JavaScript/TypeScript - Python - Rust
The APIs are designed to be as close as possible to the Orama Cloud APIs, so you can easily migrate your projects from Orama Cloud to Orama Open Source and vice-versa.
